test_title: SSC Selection Post 2024 (Graduate Level) Official Paper (Held On: 26 Jun, 2024 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
Select the correct active voice of the given sentence

Why was such a letter written by Rupesh?

options.text: Why did Rupesh wrote such a letter?
Why has Rupesh writes such a letter?
Why is Rupesh write such a letter?
Why did Rupesh write such a letter?

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In passive voice, the sentence is: **"Why was such a letter written by Rupesh?"**
 
• To convert to active voice, the subject** "Rupesh" **should come first, followed by the verb and the object.
 
• Ensure the question format is maintained with appropriate auxiliary verb "did" for past tense questions.
 
• Correct verb form should be used;** "written"** changes to "write" to match the base form after "did."
 
• Other options use incorrect verb forms ("wrote" instead of "write") or incorrect auxiliary verb.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Why did Rupesh write such a letter?"*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1:** "Why did Rupesh wrote such a letter?" – Incorrect verb form "wrote" after "did."
 
• **Option 2:** "Why has Rupesh writes such a letter?" – Incorrect auxiliary verb "has" and verb form "writes."
 
• **Option 3:** "Why is Rupesh write such a letter?" – Incorrect auxiliary verb "is" and verb form "write."
